ayahs.textUthmani: الٓمٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: الٓمٓ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: ال࢜مّ࢜ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Meem.[1138]
ayahs.transliteration: Alif-Laam-Meem
ayahs.translationClear: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmani: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: غُلِبَتِ ٱلرُّومُ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: غُلِبَتِ الرُّوْمُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: The Byzantines have been defeated[1139]
ayahs.transliteration: Ghulibatir-room
ayahs.translationClear: The Romans have been defeated.

ayahs.textUthmani: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِىٓ أَدْنَى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَهُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فِيْٓ اَدْنَي الْاَرْضِ وَهُمْ مِّنْۢ بَعْدِ غَلَبِهِمْ سَيَغْلِبُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: In the nearest land.[1140] But they, after their defeat, will overcome
ayahs.transliteration: Fee adnal-ardi wahum mim ba'di ghalabihim sayaghliboon

footnotes.1140: Another meaning is "in the lowest land."

ayahs.translationClear: In a nearby territory. But following their defeat, they will be victorious.

ayahs.textUthmani: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فِى بِضْعِ سِنِينَ‌ۗ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْرُ مِن قَبْلُ وَمِنۢ بَعْدُ‌ۚ وَيَوْمَئِذٍ يَفْرَحُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فِيْ بِضْعِ سِنِيْنَ࣢ؕ لِلّٰهِ الْاَمْرُ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَمِنْۢ بَعْدُؕ وَيَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّفْرَحُ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Within three to nine years. To Allāh belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the believers will rejoice
ayahs.transliteration: Fee bid'i sineena lillaahil-amru min qablu wamim ba'du wayawma'idhin yafrahul-mu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: In a few years. The matter is up to Allah, in the past, and in the future. On that day, the believers will rejoice.

ayahs.textUthmani: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بِنَصْرِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ يَنصُرُ مَن يَشَآءُ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: بِنَصْرِ اللّٰهِؕ يَنْصُرُ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُؕ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: In the victory of Allāh.[1141] He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.transliteration: Binasrillaahi yansuru man yashaa'u wahuwal-'azeezur-raheem

footnotes.1141: i.e., the victory given by Allāh to a people of the Scripture (Christians) over the Magians of Persia.

ayahs.translationClear: In Allah’s support. He supports whomever He wills. He is the Almighty, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَعْدَ اللّٰهِؕ لَا يُخْلِفُ اللّٰهُ وَعْدَهٗ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [It is] the promise of Allāh. Allāh does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'dallaahi laa yukhlifullaahu wa'dahoo walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: The promise of Allah—Allah never breaks His promise, but most people do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَـٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يَعْلَمُونَ ظَـٰهِرًا مِّنَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ هُمْ غَـٰفِلُونَ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: يَعْلَمُوْنَ ظَاهِرًا مِّنَ الْحَيٰوةِ الدُّنْيَاۚۖ وَهُمْ عَنِ الْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ غٰفِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
ayahs.transliteration: Ya'lamoona zaahiram minal-hayaatid-dunyaa wahum 'anil-aakhirati hum ghaafiloon
ayahs.translationClear: They know an outer aspect of the worldly life, but they are heedless of the Hereafter.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم‌ۗ مَّا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى‌ۗ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِلِقَآئِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكَـٰفِرُونَ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَتَفَكَّرُوْا فِيْٓ اَنْفُسِهِمْࣞ مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا͏ٓ اِلَّا بِالْحَقِّ وَاَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيؕ وَاِنَّ كَثِيْرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ بِلِقَا࢜ي͏ٔ͏ِ رَبِّهِمْ لَكٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not contemplate within themselves?[1142] Allāh has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim maa khalaqallaahus-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa illaa bil-haqqi wa'ajalim musamman wa'inna katheeram minan-naasi biliqaa'i rabbihim lakaafiroon

footnotes.1142: An additional meaning is "Do they not contemplate concerning themselves."

ayahs.translationClear: Do they not reflect within themselves? Allah did not create the heavens and the earth, and what is between them, except with reason, and for a specific duration. But most people, regarding meeting their Lord, are disbelievers.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ‌ۚ كَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَأَثَارُوا۟ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوهَآ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوهَا وَجَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ‌ۖ فَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَسِيْرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ فَيَنْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْؕ كَانُوْٓا اَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَّاَثَارُوا الْاَرْضَ وَعَمَرُوْهَا͏ٓ اَكْثَرَ مِمَّا عَمَرُوْهَا وَجَا࢜ءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِؕ فَمَا كَانَ اللّٰهُ لِيَظْلِمَهُمْ وَلٰكِنْ كَانُوْٓا اَنْفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُوْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: Have they not traveled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they plowed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And Allāh would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim kaanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan wa'athaarul-arda wa'amaroohaa akthara mimmaa 'amaroohaa wajaa'at'hum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati famaa kaanallaahu liyazlimahum walaakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Have they not traveled the earth and seen how those before them ended up? They were more powerful than them, and they cultivated the land and developed it more than they developed it, and their messengers came to them with clear signs. Allah would never wrong them, but they used to wrong themselves.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ ٱلسُّوٓأَىٰٓ أَن كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَكَانُوا۟ بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَاقِبَةَ الَّذِيْنَ اَسَا࢜ءُوا السُّوْ࢜اٰ͏ٓي اَنْ كَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ وَكَانُوْا بِهَا يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of Allāh and used to ridicule them.
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma kaana 'aaqibatal-ladheena asaa'us-soo'aa an kadhdhaboo bi'aayaatillaahi wakaanoo bihaa yastahzi'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Then, evil was the end of those who committed evil. That is because they rejected Allah’s revelations, and used to ridicule them.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ يَبْدَو͏ٔ͏ُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُهٗ ثُمَّ اِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Allāh begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahu yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo thumma ilayhi turja'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah originates creation, and then repeats it. Then to Him you will be returned.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يُبْلِسُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yublisul-mujrimoon
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the Hour takes place, the guilty will despair.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُم مِّن شُرَكَآئِهِمْ شُفَعَـٰٓؤُا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ لَّهُمْ مِّنْ شُرَكَا࢜ىِٕهِمْ شُفَعٰ࢜و͏ٔ͏ُا وَكَانُوْا بِشُرَكَا࢜ىِٕهِمْ كٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
ayahs.transliteration: Walam yakul lahum min shurakaa'ihim shufa'aa'u wakaanoo bishurakaa'ihim kaafireen
ayahs.translationClear: They will have no intercessors from among their idols, and they will disown their partners.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّتَفَرَّقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yawma'idhin yatafarraqoon
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the Hour takes place—on that Day they will separate.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَهُمْ فِى رَوْضَةٍ يُحْبَرُونَ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَهُمْ فِيْ رَوْضَةٍ يُّحْبَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati fahum fee rawdatin yuhbaroon
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who believed and did good deeds—they will be delighted in meadows.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَلِقَآئِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُونَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا وَكَذَّبُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا وَلِقَا࢜ي͏ٔ͏ِ الْاٰخِرَةِ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ فِي الْعَذَابِ مُحْضَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ammal-ladheena kafaroo wakadhdhaboo bi'aayaatinaa waliqaa'il-aakhirati fa'ulaa'ika fil-'adhaabi muhdaroon
ayahs.translationClear: But as for those who disbelieved, and rejected Our signs and the encounter of the Hereafter—those will be hauled into the torment.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَسُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ حِينَ تُمْسُونَ وَحِينَ تُصْبِحُونَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَسُبْحٰنَ اللّٰهِ حِيْنَ تُمْسُوْنَ وَحِيْنَ تُصْبِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So exalted is Allāh when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
ayahs.transliteration: Fasubhaanallaahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoon
ayahs.translationClear: So glorify Allah when you retire at night, and when you rise in the morning.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُ ٱلْحَمْدُ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَحِينَ تُظْهِرُونَ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَعَشِيًّا وَّحِيْنَ تُظْهِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
ayahs.transliteration: Walahul-hamdu fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wa'ashiyyan waheena tuz'hiroon
ayahs.translationClear: His is the praise in the heavens and on earth, and in the evening, and when you reach midday.

ayahs.textUthmani: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ وَيُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا‌ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: يُخْرِجُ الْحَيَّ مِنَ الْمَيِّتِ وَيُخْرِجُ الْمَيِّتَ مِنَ الْحَيِّ وَيُحْيِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاؕ وَكَذٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.[1143]
ayahs.transliteration: Yukhrijul-hayya minal-mayyiti wayukhrijul-mayyita minal-hayyi wayuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa wakadhaalika tukhrajoon

footnotes.1143: Of the graves or out of the earth at the time of resurrection.

ayahs.translationClear: He brings the living out of the dead, and He brings the dead out of the living, and He revives the land after it had died. Likewise you will be resurrected.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَنتُم بَشَرٌ تَنتَشِرُونَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ اِذَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ بَشَرٌ تَنْتَشِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee an khalaqakum min turaabin thumma idhaa antum basharun tantashiroon
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; and behold, you become humans spreading out.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُمْ مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْ اَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوْٓا اِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُمْ مَّوَدَّةً وَّرَحْمَةًؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwaajal litaskunoo ilayhaa waja'ala baynakum mawaddatan warahmatan inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmin yatafakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, so that you may find tranquility in them; and He planted love and compassion between you. In this are signs for people who reflect.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ خَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱخْتِلَـٰفُ أَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَأَلْوَٰنِكُمْ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْعَـٰلِمِينَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ خَلْقُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ وَاخْتِلَافُ اَلْسِنَتِكُمْ وَاَلْوَانِكُمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْعٰلِمِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee khalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi wakhtilaafu alsinatikum wa'alwaanikum inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil lil'aalimeen
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the diversity of your languages and colors. In this are signs for those who know.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبْتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦٓ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَسْمَعُونَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ مَنَامُكُمْ بِالَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَابْتِغَا࢜و͏ٔ͏ُكُمْ مِّنْ فَضْلِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee manaamukum bil-layli wan-nahaari wabtighaa'ukum min fadlihee inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmin yasma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs are your sleep by night and day, and your pursuit of His bounty. In this are signs for people who listen.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ يُرِيكُمُ ٱلْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَيُحْىِۦ بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖ يُرِيْكُمُ الْبَرْقَ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًا وَّيُنَزِّلُ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ مَا࢜ءً فَيُحْيٖ بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightning [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee yureekumul-barqa khawfan watama'an wayunazzilu minas-samaa'i maa'an fayuhyee bihil-arda ba'da mawtihaa inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmin ya'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs is that He shows you the lightning, causing fear and hope. And He brings down water from the sky, and with it He revives the earth after it was dead. In this are signs for people who understand.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن تَقُومَ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ‌ۚ ثُمَّ إِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةً مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ إِذَآ أَنتُمْ تَخْرُجُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ تَقُوْمَ السَّمَا࢜ءُ وَالْاَرْضُ بِاَمْرِهٖؕ ثُمَّ اِذَا دَعَاكُمْ دَعْوَةًࣗۖ مِّنَ الْاَرْضِࣗۖ اِذَا͏ٓ اَنْتُمْ تَخْرُجُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee an taqoomas-samaa'u wal-ardu bi'amrihee thumma idhaa da'aakum da'watam minal-ardi idhaa antum takhrujoon
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs is that the heaven and the earth stand at His disposal. And then, when He calls you out of the earth, you will emerge at once.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥ قَـٰنِتُونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَهٗ مَنْ فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِؕ كُلٌّ لَّهٗ قٰنِتُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
ayahs.transliteration: Walahoo man fis-samaawaati wal-ardi kullul lahoo qaanitoon
ayahs.translationClear: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. All are submissive to Him.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَهُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِ‌ۚ وَلَهُ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ‌ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَهُوَ الَّذِيْ يَبْدَو͏ٔ͏ُا الْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيْدُهٗ وَهُوَ اَهْوَنُ عَلَيْهِؕ وَلَهُ الْمَثَلُ الْاَعْلٰى فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِۚ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.transliteration: Wahuwal-ladhee yabda'ul-khalqa thumma yu'eeduhoo wahuwa ahwanu 'alayhi walahul-mathalul-a'laa fis-samaawaati wal-ardi wahuwal-'azeezul-hakeem
ayahs.translationClear: It is He who initiates creation, and then repeats it, something easy for Him. His is the highest attribute, in the heavens and the earth. He is the Almighty, the Wise.

ayahs.textUthmani: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ضَرَبَ لَكُم مَّثَلًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ‌ۖ هَل لَّكُم مِّن مَّا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُكُم مِّن شُرَكَآءَ فِى مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَأَنتُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ تَخَافُونَهُمْ كَخِيفَتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: ضَرَبَ لَكُمْ مَّثَلًا مِّنْ اَنْفُسِكُمْؕ هَلْ لَّكُمْ مِّنْ مَّا مَلَكَتْ اَيْمَانُكُمْ مِّنْ شُرَكَا࢜ءَ فِيْ مَا رَزَقْنٰكُمْ فَاَنْتُمْ فِيْهِ سَوَا࢜ءٌ تَخَافُوْنَهُمْ كَخِيْفَتِكُمْ اَنْفُسَكُمْؕ كَذٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ الْاٰيٰتِ لِقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]?[1144] Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
ayahs.transliteration: Daraba lakum mathalam min anfusikum hal lakum mim maa malakat aymaanukum min shurakaa'a fee maa razaqnaakum fa'antum feehi sawaa'un takhaafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum kadhaalika nufassilul-aayaati liqawmin ya'qiloon
ayahs.translationClear: He illustrates an example for you, from your own selves: do you make your servants full partners in the wealth We have given you? Do you revere them as you revere one another? We thus explain the revelations for a people who understand.

ayahs.textUthmani: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: بَلِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ‌ۖ فَمَن يَهْدِى مَنْ أَضَلَّ ٱللَّهُ‌ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: بَلِ اتَّبَعَ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْٓا اَهْوَا࢜ءَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۚ فَمَنْ يَّهْدِيْ مَنْ اَضَلَّ اللّٰهُؕ وَمَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom Allāh has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
ayahs.transliteration: Balittaba'al-ladheena zalamoo ahwaa'ahum bighayri 'ilmin faman yahdee man adallallaahu wamaa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.translationClear: Yet the wrongdoers follow their desires without knowledge. But who can guide whom Allah leaves astray? They will have no helpers.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا ۚ فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ حَنِيفًا‌ۚ فِطْرَتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى فَطَرَ ٱلنَّاسَ عَلَيْهَا‌ۚ لَا تَبْدِيلَ لِخَلْقِ ٱللَّهِ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْقَيِّمُ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّيْنِ حَنِيْفًاؕ فِطْرَتَ اللّٰهِ الَّتِيْ فَطَرَ النَّاسَ عَلَيْهَاؕ لَا تَبْدِيْلَ لِخَلْقِ اللّٰهِؕ ذٰلِكَ الدِّيْنُ الْقَيِّمُࣗۙ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ ࣗۙ
ayahs.translation: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fiṭrah[1145] of Allāh upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of Allāh.[1146] That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'aqim wajhaka liddeeni haneefan fitratallaahil-latee fataran-naasa 'alayhaa laa tabdeela likhalqillaahi dhaalikad-deenul-qayyimu walaakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon

footnotes.1145: The natural inborn inclination of man to worship his Creator prior to the corruption of his nature by external influences. Thus, Islāmic monotheism is described as the religion of fiṭrah - that of the inherent nature of mankind.
footnotes.1146: i.e., let people remain true to their fiṭrah within the religion of Islām.

ayahs.translationClear: So devote yourself to the religion of monotheism—the natural instinct Allah has instilled in mankind. There is no altering Allah’s creation. This is the true religion, but most people do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ مُنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ ۝٣١
ayahs.textIndopak: مُنِيْبِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ وَاتَّقُوْهُ وَاَقِيْمُوا الصَّلٰوةَ وَلَا تَكُوْنُوْا مِنَ الْمُشْرِكِيْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with Allāh
ayahs.transliteration: Muneebeena ilayhi wattaqoohu wa'aqeemus-salaata walaa takoonoo minal-mushrikeen
ayahs.translationClear: Turning towards Him—and be conscious of Him, and perform the prayer, and do not be of the idolaters.

ayahs.textUthmani: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ فَرَّقُوا۟ دِينَهُمْ وَكَانُوا۟ شِيَعًا‌ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ ۝٣٢
ayahs.textIndopak: مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَّقُوْا دِيْنَهُمْ وَكَانُوْا شِيَعًاؕ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.[1147]
ayahs.transliteration: Minal-ladheena farraqoo deenahum wakaanoo shiya'an kullu hizbim bimaa ladayhim farihoon
ayahs.translationClear: Of those who divided their religion, and became sects; each faction pleased with what they have.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلنَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا۟ رَبَّهُم مُّنِيبِينَ إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَآ أَذَاقَهُم مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ ۝٣٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا مَسَّ النَّاسَ ضُرٌّ دَعَوْا رَبَّهُمْ مُّنِيْبِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا͏ٓ اَذَاقَهُمْ مِّنْهُ رَحْمَةً اِذَا فَرِيْقٌ مِّنْهُمْ بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa massan-naasa durrun da'aw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma idhaa adhaaqahum minhu rahmatan idhaa fareequm minhum birabbihim yushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: When affliction touches the people, they call on their Lord, turning to Him in repentance. But then, when He gives them a taste of His mercy, some of them attribute partners to their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ‌ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٣٤
ayahs.textIndopak: لِيَكْفُرُوْا بِمَا͏ٓ اٰتَيْنٰهُمْؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوْاࣟ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So that they will deny what We have granted them.[1148] Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyakfuroo bimaa aataynaahum fatamatta'oo fasawfa ta'lamoon

footnotes.1148: Or "So let them deny what We have granted them."

ayahs.translationClear: To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Indulge yourselves—you will surely know.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يُشْرِكُونَ ۝٣٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطٰنًا فَهُوَ يَتَكَلَّمُ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يُشْرِكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or have We sent down to them an authority [i.e., a proof or scripture], and it speaks of what they have been associating with Him?
ayahs.transliteration: Am anzalnaa 'alayhim sultaanan fahuwa yatakallamu bimaa kaanoo bihee yushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: Have We sent down to them any authority, which speaks in support of their idols?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِذَآ أَذَقْنَا ٱلنَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوا۟ بِهَا‌ۖ وَإِن تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّئَةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ أَيْدِيهِمْ إِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُونَ ۝٣٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِذَا͏ٓ اَذَقْنَا النَّاسَ رَحْمَةً فَرِحُوْا بِهَاؕ وَاِنْ تُصِبْهُمْ سَيِّي͏ٔ͏َةٌۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتْ اَيْدِيْهِمْ اِذَا هُمْ يَقْنَطُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'idhaa adhaqnan-naasa rahmatan farihoo bihaa wa'in tusibhum sayyi'atum bimaa qaddamat aydeehim idhaa hum yaqnatoon
ayahs.translationClear: When We give people a taste of mercy, they rejoice in it. But when adversity befalls them, because of what their hands have perpetrated, they begin to despair.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبْسُطُ ٱلرِّزْقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقْدِرُ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُؤْمِنُونَ ۝٣٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَبْسُطُ الرِّزْقَ لِمَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ وَيَقْدِرُؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Do they not see that Allāh extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annallaaha yabsutur-rizqa liman yashaa'u wayaqdiru inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatil liqawmin yu'minoon
ayahs.translationClear: Do they not see that Allah expands the provision for whomever He wills, or restricts it? Surely in this are signs for people who believe.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَـَٔاتِ ذَا ٱلْقُرْبَىٰ حَقَّهُۥ وَٱلْمِسْكِينَ وَٱبْنَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ‌ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ ۝٣٨
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاٰتِ ذَا الْقُرْبٰى حَقَّهٗ وَالْمِسْكِيْنَ وَابْنَ السَّبِيْلِؕ ذٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لِّلَّذِيْنَ يُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللّٰهِؗ وَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveler. That is best for those who desire the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh, and it is they who will be the successful.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'aati dhal-qurbaa haqqahoo wal-miskeena wabnas-sabeeli dhaalika khayrul lilladheena yureedoona wajhallaahi wa'ulaa'ika humul-muflihoon
ayahs.translationClear: So give the relative his rights, and the destitute, and the wayfarer. That is best for those who seek Allah’s presence. Those are the prosperous.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِ ٱلنَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوا۟ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ وَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُم مِّن زَكَوٰةٍ تُرِيدُونَ وَجْهَ ٱللَّهِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُضْعِفُونَ ۝٣٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اٰتَيْتُمْ مِّنْ رِّبًا لِّيَرْبُوَا۟ فِيْٓ اَمْوَالِ النَّاسِ فَلَا يَرْبُوْا عِنْدَ اللّٰهِۚ وَمَا͏ٓ اٰتَيْتُمْ مِّنْ زَكٰوةٍ تُرِيْدُوْنَ وَجْهَ اللّٰهِ فَاُولٰ࢜ىِٕكَ هُمُ الْمُضْعِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people[1149] will not increase with Allāh. But what you give in zakāh,[1150] desiring the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh - those are the multipliers.[1151]
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa aataytum mir ribal liyarbuwa fee amwaalin-naasi falaa yarboo 'indallaahi wamaa aataytum min zakaatin tureedoona wajhallaahi fa'ulaa'ika humul-mud'ifoon

footnotes.1149: The phrase includes several connotations, among them: a) that which is given as usury or interest, b) that which is given on the condition that it be repaid with interest, and c) a gift given with the intention of obtaining from the recipient greater benefit or a larger gift.
footnotes.1150: The meaning of ṣadaqah (voluntary charity) is included here.
footnotes.1151: Of their blessings on earth and their rewards in the Hereafter.

ayahs.translationClear: The usury you practice, seeking thereby to multiply people’s wealth, will not multiply with Allah. But what you give in charity, desiring Allah’s approval—these are the multipliers.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ‌ۖ هَلْ مِن شُرَكَآئِكُم مَّن يَفْعَلُ مِن ذَٰلِكُم مِّن شَىْءٍ‌ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَـٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ ۝٤٠
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ رَزَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيْكُمْؕ هَلْ مِنْ شُرَكَا࢜ىِٕكُمْ مَّنْ يَّفْعَلُ مِنْ ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنْ شَيْءٍؕ سُبْحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰى عَمَّا يُشْرِكُوْنَ ࣖ

words.translation: He will cause you to die

ayahs.translation: Allāh is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your "partners" who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaa'ikum man yaf'alu min dhaalikum min shay'in subhaanahoo wata'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah is He who created you, then provides for you, then makes you die, then brings you back to life. Can any of your idols do any of that? Glorified is He, and exalted above what they associate.

ayahs.textUthmani: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ظَهَرَ ٱلْفَسَادُ فِى ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ أَيْدِى ٱلنَّاسِ لِيُذِيقَهُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٤١
ayahs.textIndopak: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَالْبَحْرِ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ اَيْدِي النَّاسِ لِيُذِيْقَهُمْ بَعْضَ الَّذِيْ عَمِلُوْا لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ

words.translation: so that He may let them taste

ayahs.translation: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., Allāh] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
ayahs.transliteration: Zaharal-fasaadu fil-barri wal-bahri bimaa kasabat aydin-naasi liyudheeqahum ba'dal-ladhee 'amiloo la'allahum yarji'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Corruption has appeared on land and sea, because of what people’s hands have earned, in order to make them taste some of what they have done, so that they might return.

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلُ‌ۚ كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّشْرِكِينَ ۝٤٢
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ سِيْرُوْا فِي الْاَرْضِ فَانْظُرُوْا كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الَّذِيْنَ مِنْ قَبْلُؕ كَانَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ مُّشْرِكِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Qul seeroo fil-ardi fanzuroo kayfa kaana 'aaqibatul-ladheena min qablu kaana aktharuhum mushrikeen
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “Roam the earth, and observe the fate of those who came before. Most of them were idolaters.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّينِ ٱلْقَيِّمِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِىَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ‌ۖ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصَّدَّعُونَ ۝٤٣
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَقِمْ وَجْهَكَ لِلدِّيْنِ الْقَيِّمِ مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يَّاْتِيَ يَوْمٌ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهٗ مِنَ اللّٰهِ يَوْمَىِٕذٍ يَّصَّدَّعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from Allāh of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.[1152]
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'aqim wajhaka liddeenil-qayyimi min qabli an ya'tiya yawmul laa maradda lahoo minallaahi yawma'idhin yassadda'oon

footnotes.1152: Into those destined for Paradise and those destined for Hell.

ayahs.translationClear: So devote yourself to the upright religion, before there comes from Allah a Day that cannot be averted. On that Day, they will be shocked.

ayahs.textUthmani: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهُۥ‌ۖ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُونَ ۝٤٤
ayahs.textIndopak: مَنْ كَفَرَ فَعَلَيْهِ كُفْرُهٗۚ وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِاَنْفُسِهِمْ يَمْهَدُوْنَ ۙ
ayahs.translation: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
ayahs.transliteration: Man kafara fa'alayhi kufruhoo waman 'amila saalihan fali'anfusihim yamhadoon
ayahs.translationClear: Whoever disbelieves, upon him falls his disbelief. And whoever acts righteously—they are preparing for themselves.

ayahs.textUthmani: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ مِن فَضْلِهِۦٓ‌ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ ۝٤٥
ayahs.textIndopak: لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّلِحٰتِ مِنْ فَضْلِهٖؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الْكٰفِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: Liyajziyal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati min fadlihee innahoo laa yuhibbul-kaafireen
ayahs.translationClear: So that He may reward those who have believed and done the righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not love the ungrateful.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمِنْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦٓ أَن يُرْسِلَ ٱلرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرَٰتٍ وَلِيُذِيقَكُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَلِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ ۝٤٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمِنْ اٰيٰتِهٖٓ اَنْ يُّرْسِلَ الرِّيَاحَ مُبَشِّرٰتٍ وَّلِيُذِيْقَكُمْ مِّنْ رَّحْمَتِهٖ وَلِتَجْرِيَ الْفُلْكُ بِاَمْرِهٖ وَلِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Wamin aayaatihee an yursilar-riyaaha mubashshiraatin waliyudheeqakum mir rahmatihee walitajriyal-fulku bi'amrihee walitabtaghoo min fadlihee wala'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.translationClear: And of His signs is that He sends the winds bearing good news, to give you a taste of His mercy, and so that the ships may sail by His command, and so that you may seek of His bounty, and so that you may give thanks.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَآءُوهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟‌ۖ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۝٤٧
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اَرْسَلْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِكَ رُسُلًا اِلٰى قَوْمِهِمْ فَجَا࢜ءُوْهُمْ بِالْبَيِّنٰتِ فَانْتَقَمْنَا مِنَ الَّذِيْنَ اَجْرَمُوْاؕ وَكَانَ حَقًّا عَلَيْنَا نَصْرُ الْمُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was support[1153] of the believers.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad arsalnaa min qablika rusulan ilaa qawmihim fajaa'oohum bil-bayyinaati fantaqamnaa minal-ladheena ajramoo wakaana haqqan 'alaynaa nasrul-mu'mineen

footnotes.1153: i.e., aid or the bestowal of victory.

ayahs.translationClear: Before you, We sent messengers to their people. They came to them with clear proofs. Then We took revenge on those who sinned. It is incumbent on Us to help the believers.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ ۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ فَتُثِيرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهُۥ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ وَيَجْعَلُهُۥ كِسَفًا فَتَرَى ٱلْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلَـٰلِهِۦ‌ۖ فَإِذَآ أَصَابَ بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ إِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ ۝٤٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ يُرْسِلُ الرِّيٰحَ فَتُثِيْرُ سَحَابًا فَيَبْسُطُهٗ فِي السَّمَا࢜ءِ كَيْفَ يَشَا࢜ءُ وَيَجْعَلُهٗ كِسَفًا فَتَرَي الْوَدْقَ يَخْرُجُ مِنْ خِلٰلِهٖۚ فَاِذَا͏ٓ اَصَابَ بِهٖ مَنْ يَّشَا࢜ءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهٖٓ اِذَا هُمْ يَسْتَبْشِرُوْنَ ۚ

words.translation: He causes it to fall on
He causes it to fall on

ayahs.translation: It is Allāh who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahul-ladhee yursilur-riyaaha fatutheeru sahaaban fayabsutuhoo fis-samaa'i kayfa yashaa'u wayaj'aluhoo kisafan fataral-wadqa yakhruju min khilaalihee fa'idhaa asaaba bihee man yashaa'u min 'ibaadihee idhaa hum yastabshiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah is He who sends the winds. They stir up clouds. Then He spreads them in the sky as He wills. And He breaks them apart. Then you see raindrops issuing from their midst. Then, when He makes it fall upon whom He wills of His servants, behold, they rejoice.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِم مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمُبْلِسِينَ ۝٤٩
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاِنْ كَانُوْا مِنْ قَبْلِ اَنْ يُّنَزَّلَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِّنْ قَبْلِهٖ لَمُبْلِسِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'in kaanoo min qabli an yunazzala 'alayhim min qablihee lamubliseen
ayahs.translationClear: Although they were before this—before it was sent down upon them—in despair.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِ رَحْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ‌ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ‌ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ۝٥٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَانْظُرْ اِلٰٓي اٰثٰرِ رَحْمَتِ اللّٰهِ كَيْفَ يُحْيِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَاؕ اِنَّ ذٰلِكَ لَمُحْيِ الْمَوْتٰىۚ وَهُوَ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرٌ
ayahs.translation: So observe the effects of the mercy of Allāh - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Fanzur ilaa aathaari rahmatillaahi kayfa yuhyil-arda ba'da mawtihaa inna dhaalika lamuhyil-mawtaa wahuwa 'alaa kulli shay'in qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: So observe the effects of Allah’s mercy—how He revives the earth after it was dead. Indeed, He is the Reviver of the dead. He is Capable of everything.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَئِنْ أَرْسَلْنَا رِيحًا فَرَأَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ يَكْفُرُونَ ۝٥١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَىِٕنْ اَرْسَلْنَا رِيْحًا فَرَاَوْهُ مُصْفَرًّا لَّظَلُّوْا مِنْۢ بَعْدِهٖ يَكْفُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.[1154]
ayahs.transliteration: Wala'in arsalnaa reehan fara'awhu musfarral lazalloo mim ba'dihee yakfuroon

footnotes.1154: Denying and ungrateful for the previous favors of Allāh.

ayahs.translationClear: But if We send a wind, and they see it turning things yellow, they would continue thereafter to disbelieve.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَإِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ ۝٥٢
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ الْمَوْتٰى وَلَا تُسْمِعُ الصُّمَّ الدُّعَا࢜ءَ اِذَا وَلَّوْا مُدْبِرِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'innaka laa tusmi'ul-mawtaa walaa tusmi'us-summad-du'aa'a idhaa wallaw mudbireen
ayahs.translationClear: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call when they turn away.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَـٰدِ ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَـٰلَتِهِمْ‌ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ ۝٥٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَا͏ٓ اَنْتَ بِهٰدِ الْعُمْيِ عَنْ ضَلٰلَتِهِمْؕ اِنْ تُسْمِعُ اِلَّا مَنْ يُّو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا فَهُمْ مُّسْلِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Wamaa anta bihaadil-'umyi 'an dalaalatihim in tusmi'u illaa man yu'minu bi'aayaatinaa fahum muslimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Nor can you guide the blind out of their error. You can make hear only those who believe in Our signs, and so have submitted.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن ضَعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ضَعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضَعْفًا وَشَيْبَةً‌ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ‌ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْقَدِيرُ ۝٥٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَكُمْ مِّنْ ضُؔعْفٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ضُؔعْفٍ قُوَّةً ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ ضُؔعْفًا وَّشَيْبَةًؕ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَا࢜ءُۚ وَهُوَ الْعَلِيْمُ الْقَدِيْرُ
ayahs.translation: Allāh is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqakum min da'fin thumma ja'ala mim ba'di da'fin quwwatan thumma ja'ala mim ba'di quwwatin da'fan washaybatan yakhluqu maa yashaa'u wahuwal-'aleemul-qadeer
ayahs.translationClear: Allah is He who created you weak, then after weakness gave you strength, then after strength gave you weakness and gray hair. He creates whatever He wills. He is the Omniscient, the Omnipotent.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ مَا لَبِثُوا۟ غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍ‌ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كَانُوا۟ يُؤْفَكُونَ ۝٥٥
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يُقْسِمُ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ࣢ۙ مَا لَبِثُوْا غَيْرَ سَاعَةٍؕ كَذٰلِكَ كَانُوْا يُو͏ٔ͏ْفَكُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
ayahs.transliteration: Wayawma taqoomus-saa'atu yuqsimul-mujrimoona maa labithoo ghayra saa'atin kadhaalika kaanoo yu'fakoon
ayahs.translationClear: On the Day when the Hour takes place, the sinners will swear they had stayed but an hour. Thus they were deluded.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ وَٱلْإِيمَـٰنَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْبَعْثِ‌ۖ فَهَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْبَعْثِ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ ۝٥٦
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالَ الَّذِيْنَ اُوْتُوا الْعِلْمَ وَالْاِيْمَانَ لَقَدْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِيْ كِتٰبِ اللّٰهِ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْبَعْثِؗ فَهٰذَا يَوْمُ الْبَعْثِ وَلٰكِنَّكُمْ كُنْتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But those who were given knowledge and faith will say, "You remained the extent of Allāh's decree until the Day of Resurrection, and this is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not used to know."[1155]
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaalal-ladheena ootul-'ilma wal-eemaana laqad labithtum fee kitaabillaahi ilaa yawmil-ba'thi fahaadhaa yawmul-ba'thi walaakinnakum kuntum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.translationClear: But those endowed with knowledge and faith will say, “You remained in Allah’s Book until the Day of Resurrection. This is the Day of Resurrection, but you did not know.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ ۝٥٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَيَوْمَىِٕذٍ لَّا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِيْنَ ظَلَمُوْا مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ

words.translation: will be allowed to make amends

ayahs.translation: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allāh].
ayahs.transliteration: Fayawma'idhil laa yanfa'ul-ladheena zalamoo ma'dhiratuhum walaa hum yusta'taboon
ayahs.translationClear: On that Day, the sinners’ excuses will not benefit them, nor will they be excused.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍ‌ۚ وَلَئِن جِئْتَهُم بِـَٔايَةٍ لَّيَقُولَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُبْطِلُونَ ۝٥٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِيْ هٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ مِنْ كُلِّ مَثَلٍؕ وَلَىِٕنْ جِي͏ٔ͏ْتَهُمْ بِاٰيَةٍ لَّيَقُوْلَنَّ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِنْ اَنْتُمْ اِلَّا مُبْطِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We have certainly presented to the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example. But, [O Muḥammad], if you should bring them a sign, the disbelievers will surely say, "You [believers] are but falsifiers."
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad darabnaa linnaasi fee haadhal-qur'aani min kulli mathalin wala'in ji'tahum bi'aayatil layaqoolannal-ladheena kafaroo in antum illaa mubtiloon
ayahs.translationClear: We have cited in this Quran for the people every sort of parable. But even if you bring them a miracle, those who disbelieve will say, “You are nothing but fakers.”

ayahs.textUthmani: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۝٥٩
ayahs.textIndopak: كَذٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى قُلُوْبِ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Thus does Allāh seal the hearts of those who do not know.[1156]
ayahs.transliteration: Kadhaalika yatba'ullaahu 'alaa quloobil-ladheena laa ya'lamoon

footnotes.1156: i.e., those who do not wish to know the truth and refuse it.

ayahs.translationClear: Allah thus seals the hearts of those who do not know.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ‌ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُوقِنُونَ ۝٦٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاصْبِرْ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّلَا يَسْتَخِفَّنَّكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: So be patient. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And let them not disquiet you who are not certain [in faith].
ayahs.transliteration: Fasbir inna wa'dallaahi haqqun walaa yastakhiffannakal-ladheena laa yooqinoon
ayahs.translationClear: So be patient. The promise of Allah is true. And do not let those who lack certainty belittle you.
